ValidationRule.description: #21306- Restrict users from editing Currency on Won Opportunities #25605-add bypass logic with permission set for user to edit currency field in late stages.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula:
AND( ISCHANGED(CurrencyIsoCode),
OR( ISPICKVAL(StageName, '5 - Signed/PO in'), ISPICKVAL(StageName, '6 - Setup'), ISPICKVAL(StageName, '7 - Closed')),
NOT(PRIORVALUE(StageName)='4 - Negotiate'),
$Profile.Name <> 'System Administrator', $Profile.Name <> 'IM_Custom Sys Admin', NOT($Permission.Edit_Closed_Opportunity_Currency), NOT($Permission.VR_Bypass_Permission)
)
ValidationRule.errorMessage: You cannot update Currency once an Opportunity has been Won. Need help? Contact your Sales Operations Business Partner.
